clarifications.PROFIT_TRAIL_FULL: After the arm threshold is first touched, the full-position protective stop becomes max(entry_price, prior_peak_price * (1 - trail_giveback_roe/300)). It is active from the next 15m bar. Current-bar high cannot retroactively tighten a stop against the current-bar low.
clarifications.PARTIAL_CONTINUATION: After T1, the residual stop is max(entry-derived residual floor, prior_peak-derived trail). It is active from the next 15m bar.
clarifications.SPLIT_MEAN_STATE_AND_SPLIT_COUNTERTREND_: After the completed-bar T1 trigger executes at the next open, residual floor protection is active from that execution bar and the residual BB-improvement target is evaluated on subsequent completed bars.
clarifications.FAILURE_CHECKPOINT: Evaluate once, at the first completed bar whose close time is at or after failure_h. A candidate that passes this checkpoint is not repeatedly failed later by the same checkpoint rule.
clarifications.MAX_HOLD: Exit at the open exactly max_hold_h after entry if no earlier strategic or risk exit occurred.
